about.title: About Mayo Creative Chinese
about.subtitle: Smart learning methodologies & creative thinking to elevate your language skills
about.motto_content: “A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step”. We believe that learning Chinese should not just stop at communication or certificate tests, but must become a practical tool that creates value in your career.
about.pillar.hsk_desc: Structured path following international HSK standards, developing listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills.
about.pillar.practical_desc: Pioneering the connection between Chinese and high-demand industries such as Business, Trade, Logistics, and E-commerce.
about.pillar.classroom_desc: Assignments managed through Google Classroom, with detailed grading and individual pronunciation checks.
about.pillar.sessions_desc: The first 2 sessions focus entirely on mastering Pinyin to build a native-like accent foundation.
teachers.title: Our Professional Team
teachers.subtitle: MCC brings together talented, dedicated teachers graduated from top universities and CSC full scholarship recipients.
teacher.mai.name: Ms. Luu Ngoc Mai
teacher.mai.bio: Outstanding FTU Graduate. Master of International Business at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics (SUFE) under CSC full scholarship. Holds HSK6 and HSKK Advanced. Taught 70+ classes and helped 400+ students achieve HSK goals.
teacher.thao.name: Ms. Nguyen Thi Phuong Thao
teacher.thao.bio: Good FTU Graduate in Business Chinese & Foreign Economics. Achieved HSK6 (254 pts) and HSKK Advanced. 3+ years teaching experience, former key lecturer at large training centers.
teacher.ly.name: Ms. Nguyen Huong Ly
teacher.ly.bio: FTU Graduate in Foreign Economics & Business Chinese. Achieved HSK6 (242 pts) and HSKK Advanced. Valedictorian of Lang Son province in Chinese with a perfect 10/10 score. 3.5+ years teaching experience.
teacher.dung.name: Ms. Nguyen Kieu Dung
teacher.dung.bio: Master of International Chinese Education at Anhui University under CSC full scholarship. ULIS-VNU graduate in Chinese. Achieved HSK6 (231 pts) and CTCSOL certificate. 4.5+ years teaching all levels of HSK.
teacher.linh.name: Tutor Tran Thi Khanh Linh
teacher.linh.bio: FTU High-Quality Program in Business English. Outstanding student at MCC (HSK2-4). Achieved HSK4 & HSKK Intermediate (277/300 pts) and IELTS 7.5. 1+ years experience grading assignments and assisting students.
teacher.lina.name: Ms. Ly Na (Lina)
teacher.lina.bio: Master of International Chinese Education at Anhui University. Holds CTCSOL certification. Third Prize in National Translation Competition. 4+ years of academic and conversational Chinese teaching.
teacher.hong.name: Ms. Nguyen Khanh Hong
teacher.hong.bio: Former outstanding Chinese major, recipient of the Vietnam-China Friendship Scholarship. Holds HSK6 & HSKK Advanced. Second Prize in National Chinese Oratorical Competition. 3+ years teaching & translation experience.
